The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''Rapid Deployment Airspeeder (RaDAir)''', colloquially known as '''"Raider"''', was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used by the Empire as a planetary troop transport.

==Characteristics==
The Raider was an Imperial-gray speeder based on the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], and was tasked with quickly and nimbly delivering troops or agents to a hotspot. Angular and wingless, the Raider sported less armor and armament than the LAAT and could carry only six passengers, with the passengers being completely enclosed in a troop bay which was sealed off by twin sliding doors to the aft, the cockpit situated behind a mirrored opaque canopy. Total armaments available to the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] were turreted dorsal and chin mounted double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]].

A single airspeeder cost 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], or 30,000 credits if used.

==History==
The RaDAir was used on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rapidly deliver small units of soldiers to trouble hotspots. The [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] often used such vehicles to enter combat situations. The RaDAir was known to produce a high-pitched whine of the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsorlifts]].
